text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
POLITICAL NEWS
RZECZPOSPOLITA

- Poland's Economy Minister Wieslaw Kaczmarek and Lithuania's Economy Minister Vincas Babilius have discussed opening branches of Polish banks in Lithuania and Lithuanian banks in Poland to reduce risks in trade exchanges.
DZIENNIK PRAWA I GOSPODARKI
- Sweden will present Poland's flood victims with aid worth 15.5 million zlotys, the Swedish Prime Minister Goeran Persson said during his visit in the flooded regions of southern Poland.

- The state financial assistance to flood victims must not increase the budget deficit and spur inflation and should be a part of the country's economic development programme, the leader of the opposition centrist Union for Freedom (UW) Leszek Balcerowicz said.
ECONOMIC AND MARKET STORIES
RZECZPOSPOLITA

- Around 140 arms manufacturers will exhibit at the Military Industry Salon fair in Kielce, southern Poland, to start on September 1 this year. Foreign firms will make up 40 percent of the exhibitors.

- The state-owned CPN petroleum processor and distributor will rise the prices of fuel it buys from refineries located in Poland by up to 0.03 zloty. Imported lead free fuel prices will grow the most as a result of global price changes, CPN said.
- Poland's industrial climate in the manufacturing and housing industries showed a slight decline in the last 10 days of July, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.

- Germany's Beiersdorf cosmetics maker will buy a 29 percent share stake in Pollena Lechia SA, Poland's biggest cosmetics maker, worth 50 million marks. In 19 months' time Pollena Lechia will list shares on the Warsaw bourse, the company said.
- Wistil SA silk maker in Kalisz, central Poland, plans a share listing on the Warsaw bourse in the fourth quarter of 1997, Wistil said.

- The brokerage of the Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej (BGZ) agricultural sector bank has earned a net profit of 2.798 million zlotys, showing major growth compared with 108,000 zlotys in the same period last year. According to the brokerage, portfolio management services and sales of mutual trust units brought about dynamic sales' growth.
- The TFP Korona mutual trust's assets reached 194 million zlotys at the end of June 1997, showing s 271 percent increase compared with the first half of 1996, Korona said.
- Swiss Reinsurance Company will pay 150 million Swiss francs in flood-related damages to insurers in Poland, the Czech Republic and Germany, Swiss Re said.
- The Ostrow Wielkopolski municipality in western Poland will issue seven-year bonds worth 7.5 million zlotys to finance public roads modernisation works, the municipality said.
DZIENNIK PRAWA I GOSPODARKI
- The average starting monthly salary of corporate executives in Poland is 15,400 zlotys ($4,400), a survey by the SMG/KRC market research firm showed.

- The quality of easily perishable foodstuffs offered by shops and restaurants around Poland is declining dangerously with 29 percent of controlled outlets selling products past the expiry date, the state trading standards' authority (PIH) said.
GAZETA WYBORCZA

- By the end of September the telecommunications ministry will invite telecom firms to bid for operating licences for independent telephone networks to be launched in Poland's big cities, the ministry said.
